descriptions.cc39d_stream_seek_80218bc0: Seek a memory stream: optionally report the previous position, then form the target from origin 0 (offset), 2 (size + offset) or 1 (position + offset), each origin reading the size limit itself. Unsigned comparison rejects targets past the size (and wrapped negative results) with 0x90000003; unknown origins return 0x90000002; failures leave the position unchanged. Partial observed view (size +76, position +104); full type and sizeof unknown.
